responses.value: I'd look at sales by product and market, leftover inventory and discounting, factory costs, and products for other seasons. I'd start with sales by product line and country for five seasons, to see whether losses are everywhere or in a few products and markets.
Inventory and discounts. Shorter snow seasons likely leave stock unsold, so I'd check leftover stock across the three losing seasons.
